args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate ~18% at time of investigation; unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback reported VERIFIED with all regions on v2.3.0. v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are marked unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health checks recover on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback reported VERIFIED, with every region on v2.3.0.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the v2.3.1 health-check failures (about 18% error rate before the rollback), the rollback to v2.3.0, and the follow-up work. The on-call engineer was paged.

I didn't re-check service health after the rollback, so confirming that error rates and health checks have recovered on v2.3.0 is still open. The v2.3.1 failure also needs investigation before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
